x: The war has been responsible for bringing many of our older members out of retirement, and in this respite we welcome back, among others: Charlie Redgrave, Jarvis Boddington, Willis, Ted Jackman, and Goold.

A Club Handicap was held in conjunction, and once again young Mac managed to pull it off, with Doub (walking again) 2nd and Stan Goold 3rd. In January Surrey A.C. came to Wimbledon with a strong team and just managed to beat us by one point, the score being 85 point to 86.
